tour.welcomeDesc_host: You're hosting. This quick tour shows how to record the discussion, shape the statements, and read what the group really thinks.
tour.welcomeDesc_guest: Glad you're here. This quick tour shows how to add your voice, vote on statements, and see where the group stands.
tour.statusDesc: Green means you're live and in sync. If it ever shows reconnecting, we'll get you back automatically — nothing is lost.
tour.codeDesc: Anyone with this 6-character code can join the session. Tap it any time to share.
tour.inviteDesc: Share a link or QR code so people can hop in from their own phone or laptop.
tour.topicDesc_host: This frames the whole discussion. Tap to edit it any time so everyone knows what's being debated.
tour.topicDesc_guest: This is what the group is discussing — keep it in mind as you vote and add your own points.
tour.nameDesc: This is how you appear to others. Tap to change it whenever you like.
tour.languageDesc_host: The session language for transcription and AI analysis. Change it in Settings — captions and results follow along.
tour.languageDesc_guest: Shows the session's working language. The interface adapts to your own language automatically.
tour.themeDesc: Switch between light and dark mode any time — easy on the eyes in any setting.
tour.moveDesc: Switch between {{tabs}} here. We'll walk through each one.
tour.captureDesc: Press Record and only your device streams audio. Live captions appear below as people speak.
tour.transcriptDesc: Completed turns are transcribed here — and the AI turns them into clear claims to vote on.
tour.curateDesc: Write your own statements, or approve and reject the ones the AI suggests before they go live for the group.
tour.addGuestDesc: Have a point to make? Add a statement here — the host reviews it, then everyone can vote on it.
tour.voteDesc: Your turn — swipe right to agree, left to disagree, down for neutral. Try it now! Buttons and arrow keys work too.
tour.standsDesc: Opinion clusters update live, placing people who vote alike closer together, so you can see what unites or divides the group.
tour.groupsDesc: See the size of each opinion group and the statements that define them at a glance.
tour.cgDesc: An AI mediator drafts a statement the whole group could share — and everyone can react and vote on it.
tour.tensionsDesc: Turn the group's most divisive splits into fresh statements everyone can weigh in on — great for unblocking a debate.
tour.exportDesc: Export the full results as PDF, CSV or JSON, or copy a text summary — in your chosen language.
tour.manageDesc: Track who has voted, hand over the mic, promote a co-host, or control who can add arguments.
tour.settingsDesc: Fine-tune the spoken language, AI common ground mode, statement moderation and the vote scale — all in one place.
tour.lifetimeDesc: Every session auto-deletes when this timer runs out. Export the results before then to keep a copy.
tour.finishDesc_host: That's the tour. Start recording whenever you're ready — the session builds itself from the conversation.
tour.finishDesc_guest: That's it! Jump in, vote on the statements, and add your own points anytime.
